attributes.title: 2027 ODA Annual Meeting & Conference
attributes.summary:
The Oklahoma Dental Association holds its 2027 Annual Meeting April 30 to May 1, 2027, at the Southern Hills Marriott in Tulsa. Online registration opens January 7, 2027; the early-bird deadline is February 28 and online registration closes April 20.

Published attendee prices are $300 for ODA/ADA members, $150 for new members who graduated in 2022 or later, $620 for non-member dentists, $185 for dental hygienists and $95 to $125 for assistants and office staff. Dental students attend free.

The ODA is a locally approved AGD PACE program provider (provider ID 219266) for FAGD/MAGD credit. ODA says the meeting offers more than 30 hours of PACE-approved continuing education; how many hours one attendee can earn is not stated.
